offering_description.value: Operates golf courses and clubs, technology-enabled driving ranges, and indoor miniature golf venues for golfers, leisure visitors, and groups. It sells rounds, memberships, and game sessions and provides dining and private events at its venues. It also manages golf courses for property owners and municipalities.

primary_products.value: food and beverages; golf equipment and apparel

primary_services.value: golf course access and club memberships; interactive driving-range sessions; indoor miniature golf; food and beverage service and private events; golf course management

customer_segment.value: B2C: public golfers, club members, and recreational visitors; B2B: private golf course owners and corporate event organizers; B2G: municipal golf course owners

end_markets.value: golf and country clubs; location-based entertainment; dining and hospitality; corporate and private events; municipal recreation

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: golf rounds, driving-range bay time, and miniature golf sessions; subscription: recurring golf and country club dues; product sales: food, drinks, and pro shop merchandise; service fees: private event packages and catering; commissions or management fees: operation of golf courses for property owners and municipalities
